app.name: Wii Ran AI
app.short_description: Local stories and chat on your Wii
app.long_description: Stories, Nano text continuation, Nano Chat, or Medium Chat. D-pad selects keys; A types, B deletes, 1 shifts to symbols for one key, 2 toggles Caps Lock. Minus spaces, Plus generates, Home returns to model selection; Home quits there.
